title: Quick Assembly!
text: Quick Assembly!. These are sturdy chairs. Assembly is quick and easy. The finished chairs look awesome. My only complaint is that there's a tag on the seat with the brand name. That just seems odd. I can't ever recall seeing a branding label on furniture and if I have, it's been discreet and out of the way.

product_metadata.title: Kidol & Shellder Modern Dining Chairs Set of 2 Grey PU Upholstered Kitchen & Dining Room Chairs,Loads Up to 300lbs,3 Mins Quick Assembly

❤【Comfortable Design】: With soft seats and an ergonomic design, these dining chairs provide maximum comfort during mealtime. Say goodbye to uncomfortable, stiff chairs and hello to a relaxing dining experience.
❤【Durable Build】: Featuring thickened metal legs and adjustable foot pegs, these chairs are built to last. Enjoy a stable, wobble-free dining experience with a maximum weight capacity of 136kg.

❤【Stylish Addition】: Add a touch of elegance to your dining room with these beautiful chairs. Perfect for any kitchen or dining room, they're sure to impress your guests and elevate your home's decor.

❤【Peace of Mind】: With a 1-year warranty, you can rest easy knowing that your investment is protected. Order with confidence, knowing that you're getting a quality product backed by excellent customer service.
